definitions: A thin, crisp biscuit, typically eaten with cheese.
A paper tube that makes a sharp noise when pulled apart, containing a small gift and a joke.
A person or thing that is excellent or very attractive.
A firework that explodes with a loud crack.
A person who breaks into a computer system without authorisation.
examples: That goal was a real cracker!
The hacker turned out to be a malicious cracker.
